verdict.rationale: GitHub README claims 'full SSR and serverless support' but the evidence pack lacks specifics on deployment adapters, edge runtime targets (e.g., Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers, Netlify), or documentation of zero-config deployment; community comments note SolidStart routing issues and general immaturity. missing for 10: concrete deployment adapter list/docs for serverless or edge platforms, first-party or hands-on evidence of a no-config deploy workflow, independent confirmation of successful edge/serverless deployments.
